column1: # Exit-residue ratchet baseline (RFC-0114 s25). One row per example:
# clean: builds, exits its own code, zero residue under VYRN_LEAK_CHECK.
# leak N: at most N blocks of residue. other: exits nonzero by design.
# skip: does not build natively. A new example must be clean or carry a
# row here; shrinking a leak row is the ratchet turning.
